items.fact: The campaign has five chapters and 91 story missions, following Jason and Lucia through Leonida's criminal underworld.
Chapter 1 is set in the Leonida Keys, Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn, and Chapters 3, 4 and 5 in Vice City; Chapter 1 has 22 main missions and Chapter 5 has 7.

Chapter 2 ends with the mission Checking Out once you reach the Move to Vice City point, and the optional missions listed for it include Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab and Veteran Hunted (Jason only).
Completed story missions can't be replayed in GTA 6.
The two protagonists are Jason and Lucia. In Chapter 2 you can play Jason-only hunting missions for his old military buddy Bret in Lummox County.
Leonida is divided into 5 counties, and collectible cards are scattered across all of them.
Jason's starting house is in Key Lento, Mariana County, and the Vice City area sits in Vice-Dale County.
There are 18 collectible card sets, totalling 480 cards, and rare cards can be sold at pawn shops.
Set sizes range from 12 cards (Backyard Wrestling) to 36 (for example Jack of Hearts and Nine1Nine).
For 100% completion you need to find only 15 of the 18 card sets, plus 30 magazines, books and comics.
The Progress menu lists more than 250 animals to find and collect, including 61 hunting animals and 60 birds.
Stolen cars sell to Moses from Chapter 2, but only if they have no tracker. Randy, from Chapter 3, pays much more for flashy cars.
Large bank vault robberies pay up to $200,000. They unlock near the end of Chapter 4 after the 'That's Where The Money Is...' side quest and 2 Payday Loan jobs.
Randy's wish list has 18 high-end sports cars, and delivering one can pay $30,000 or more.
There are 40 unique race locations, and winning a race pays more than the entry and rental fees you put up.
The demolition derby at Ambrosia Raceway is easy cash, because you win by default once the other cars are wrecked.
After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, Kenton in Key Lento sends you on underwater treasure dives that pay roughly $200 to $2,600.
Hover over a robbery or gang hideout on the map to see its potential score and security level, and bring your partner along for bigger jobs.
Pre-order and Ultimate Edition vehicles include the Dinka Enduro motorcycle and Crest Kayak at Jason's house from Chapter 1, and the '67 Vapid Dominator buggy in Chapter 2.
Autosave failed for some players before the first patch, so saving manually is the safer habit.
Update 1.002.002 rolled out on November 23 and fixes crashes, autosaving, weather that stopped changing, missed story phone calls, and being unable to lose a Wanted Level.
The same patch also fixes the gym deadlift bar and partners not handing over bags to sell to fences. It is about 603.7 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S.
The first-person glitch and the Xbox 60fps glitch were not mentioned in the patch notes, and object clipping, collision and vehicle behaviour issues remain.
